veranderings.voor: en albei is maklik om saam te dra
veranderings.na: en albei instrumente is maklik om saam te dra
veranderings.rede: Straight after 'gespeel en gesing', 'albei' can be read as the playing and the singing; naming the instruments makes the reference clear.

veranderings.voor: en speel baie groepe ook 'n baskitaar en tromme
veranderings.na: en baie groepe speel ook 'n baskitaar en tromme
veranderings.rede: After the comma the second clause stands on its own, and normal subject-verb order after 'en' reads more naturally than inversion carried over from 'Vandag'.
'is net stemme' is loose spoken phrasing; 'bestaan net uit stemme' says the same thing in correct written Afrikaans.
